notes.title: Revolutionary Update: Global Leaderboards & New Boosters
notes.content:
Added a global leaderboard to each level, allowing you to compete against players worldwide.

Added brand-new Booster gameplay mechanics.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/d24001b63bd58072f209b07b4db684016e2bb366.png"]

- - Flame Grower：The Flame Grower grows peppers by 3 stages!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/beb350dc9a340953872e42216d8456ad3f200e23.png"]

- - Hammer: The Hammer removes a single pepper!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/3f558b2eda444d2ba8b4947ed19ee7febd2ce094.png"]

- - Pepper Net：The Pepper Net protects a pepper from Mister Claws!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/33ebe401c085ba24f1e8e00b3e422dd7eab1bf50.png"]

- - Firecracker：The Firecracker scares Mister Claws away for 3 turns!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/a88cb95406180bea0fc4f09052ec95ec0a688bbe.png"]

- - Flameburst Pepper：The Flameburst Pepper grows all peppers of the color you switch it with!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/819fcfcf38f91b932eb5cb1d84d1c52218e490e7.png"]

- - Heatblast Pepper: The Heatblast Pepper creates two powerful shockwaves when used in a match!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/868bf09d0b39fcac80a66fba96d4562b45df8c8c.png"]

- - Inferno Pepper：The Inferno Pepper grows all nearby peppers when used in a match!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295555/3e1d192af356434dafeab2b8108da6f9be4d3e24.png"]

- - Swapper: The Swapper can swap 2 peppers, even if they don't match!



- - Undo Move: Undo Move reverses your last move!
